questions.q: Why is the built-in Account Owner field hidden on our record pages?
o: It reads as Stephen on nearly everything, so it is misleading
It was replaced by the Case owner field
It is only visible to administrators
questions.e: It was deliberately hidden during the 1 July 2026 view overhaul so nobody derives ownership from it. Sales Rep is the truth.

questions.q: A contact signs off the budget. What Decision Role do you set?
questions.e: Economic Buyer is whoever controls the money. Champion sells for us internally; Technical Evaluator tests the kit.

questions.q: What is the Account Code on a company record?
o: The Intact A/C code, which joins the CRM record to the ERP
questions.e: It is the join key. Without it, what the account has actually bought can never be tied back to the CRM record.

questions.q: Two of our resellers are both chasing the same supermarket group. Where does the supermarket group live?
o: As a Company with Account Type set to End Client
As an End Customer record, with each reseller's deal linked to it
As a note on each reseller's record
As two company records, one per reseller
questions.e: That is the two-horse race view. One End Customer record, every competing deal rolled up under it.
